episode.title: Just Resting His Eyes
episode.scene: The bedroom corner beside the round attic window, late night. A low candle stub casts a warm honey-amber glow across a pile of folded linen quilts while deep twilight blues frame the rooftops outside. Teddy, a massive shaggy apricot Syrian hamster, has slumped forward into a heavy, boneless sleep, his cheek squashed flat against the quilt and his tiny stubby paws still loosely clasping a half-peeled pumpkin seed. Tiny silvery-white Ichigo sits squarely upright beside his huge snoozing form, solid glossy black bead eyes fixed on him in dry, unimpressed silence.
episode.caption: He insisted this was his favourite part and that he was only closing his eyes to listen better.
episode.arcNote: Teddy insisted on staying up late for a midnight snack by the window, then promptly fell asleep mid-bite.
